description: Midgard's lore, myths and places as its people tell them, from Living Server, rewritten.

lines.text: My grandfather swore the real road to Asgard starts behind a waterfall. He never said which waterfall.
Heard the Bifrost still stands, just hidden in the northern lights. Pretty story anyway.
Swam north off the edge of the map once. The sea just kept going, but I swear I saw a wall of light out there.
Every map of Midgard ends at the ice, but nobody I know has walked to where it actually ends.
I keep a list of caves nobody talks about. It is getting long.
If Odin left a door open somewhere, my bet is under the glacier. Why else would something that big just stand there.
Some say the Glacier Giant is not guarding the frontier, he is guarding a door. I half believe it.
A guildmate swore he swam so far north the stars looked wrong. I half believe him.
I like to think some of Midgard is still unwalked on purpose.
The green lights over the north are the Bifrost folded up, an old seer told me. She never said who folded it.
I remember when nobody knew what was across the water. Everyone just told stories about it.
Gjalpinulva is a daughter of the Fenris wolf, which is why she looks the way she does.
Heard Gjalpinulva talks to your corpse after she kills you. Never stuck around to listen.
Half the raid calls Gjalpinulva a he. The old songs say she. I stopped arguing about it.
The dragon drops mostly coin, if you ask me. The luminescent stones are the real reason anyone goes.
An old raid leader swore the drakulv soultrappers keep the souls of the dragon's dead. Creepy if true.
Bet nobody here has tagged the dragon solo and walked out. I want to be the first.
Heard killing the Glacier Giant takes the fire out of the dragon. I think whoever said that was drunk.
The Glacier Giant is the biggest thing in the world, I think. Nobody I have met has seen a bigger one.
Ran past the Glacier Giant at 20 once to see how close I could get. I got about ten steps.
Dare anyone to stand still next to the Glacier Giant for ten seconds. Nobody has.
We serve the house of Hel. People get nervous when I say that out loud.
The house of Odin taught me every rune is a key. I still have not found what most of them open.
The house of Thor likes us loud. It is in the oath, more or less.
Skadi's house taught us to hunt in the snow. Midgard has no shortage of cold.
The house of Loki trains the Shadowblades. Never ask us where our god is tonight.
Tyr gave his hand to the wolf. Warriors remember that every time we step in front of a pull.
Bragi watches over the Skalds. Every saga I sing is half true and the rest is for the crowd.
The house of Modi does not ask how many. Only where.
Shamans answer to the house of Ymir. Yes, that Ymir. The giants' first father.
Kelgor's house says the body is the weapon. My healer disagrees every fight.
The gods are still alive in Midgard. The other realms just have old stories.
Always found it strange that Bonedancers and the Valkyn pray to the same Bodgar.
The Valkyn pray to Bodgar, a god of the dead older than Odin himself, they say.
The Dwarves are the oldest race in Midgard and they never let you forget it.
Kobolds are drawn to runes like moths to a lamp. Ask any Runemaster.
Trolls came down out of the mountains to help us. No one remembers what they were doing up there first.
My guild leader swears Ragnarok already happened and we live in the long afterward.
If Ragnarok ever comes I want to be 50 with my armor paid off.
I figure Ragnarok cannot start while Thor's hammer sits in Midgard. So we guard it.
Some say every realm war is just practice for Ragnarok. I hope they are wrong.
The Troll fathers came before Trolls and Kobolds both. Makes you look at your Kobold friends differently.
The hrimthursa queen built her citadel over a dead dragon's bones. Nobody asks what killed the dragon.
The elder council of the hrimthursa sits right on the dragon's ribs. Strange seat for a council.
The Valkyn were Morvalt once, tamed by the Troll fathers. Then they came over to our side. I still watch them.
A Valkyn told me Bodgar was here before Odin came. I did not argue, he had the bigger axe.
If you ask me, the Morvalt dig because they lost something, not because they want something.
The Albs and Hibs call us Stungard as if it were an insult. We call it teamwork.
First time I heard someone call Midgard Stungard I laughed. Then I rolled a healer.
An old Skald swore there was a third relic, Odin's spear, lost in the ice. No one has found it.
The horn of Valhalla blows when it is carried off, some say. I have never heard it myself.
Old frontier vets get quiet when you ask what Thor's hammer looked like on its stand.
A smith told me dragon scale would make armor nobody can pierce. Never seen a scale myself.
Heard hrimthursa ice never melts. If you could forge it no blade would ever dull.
Heard Gjalpinulva is a daughter of Fenris, and the drakulvs are family.
Some swear killing the Glacier Giant takes the dragon's fire. I swear they were drunk.
Queen Kula built her citadel on a dead dragon's bones. Ask what killed that one.
The Valkyn pray to Bodgar, a god of the dead older than Odin. Nobody asks them about it.
Thor's hammer and the horn stay home. The Albs only dream.
Ragnarok already happened, my old guild swore. We live in the long afterward.
Swam north past the ice once, the sea just kept going. Turned back before it got too cold.
Back then, we swore the north hid a whole city. Then Aegir opened and we were right.
Dare: walk up to the Glacier Giant and wave. See how far you land.
A dwarven smith will swear that steel cooled in Muspelheim ash never breaks.
